news.headline: Treasury rally spills over to Indian bonds, debt supply slows move
news.summary: Indian government bonds saw slight gains, reflecting the upward trend in US Treasuries. Investors are keeping a close eye on the forthcoming weekly debt auction, pivotal for market movements. With retail inflation and fluctuating oil prices in play, the Reserve Bank of India may entertain further rate hikes. Although benchmark Brent crude holds steady, it remains vulnerable to geopolitical shifts, prompting caution among traders as they await auction results.

news.headline: Sebi plans consultation paper to remove FPI constraints absent in other markets
news.summary: SEBI is set to release a consultation paper aimed at simplifying regulations for foreign portfolio investors. The goal is to eliminate certain compliance restrictions to enhance India's appeal to global investors. SEBI also plans to expedite the onboarding process, targeting completion in just five business days. Additionally, KYC review cycles for applicable FPIs will be extended, reducing repetitive compliance activities.

news.headline: Stocks to buy: HSBC lists 19 Indian stocks that saw FY27 earnings upgrades, check target prices
news.summary: HSBC identified 19 Indian stocks with Buy ratings that received FY27 earnings upgrades after Q2 results. Ather Energy, GAIL and IIFL Finance led revisions, while improving corporate profitability highlighted a broadening earnings recovery across market capitalisations and sectors.

news.headline: AI to lead investment strategy in 2027; Energy and borrowing costs shape macro outlook: Barclays
news.summary: According to the latest report from Barclays Private Bank, the impending year 2027 calls for a stronger investment focus on artificial intelligence. While infrastructure is steadily developing, the rising costs of debt financing could negatively impact the economics of these projects. The report warns of potential computing demand outpacing supply, which may hinder technology scalability. Investors should approach government bonds with caution due to elevated yields and inflation worries.

news.headline: South Korea prepares market stabilisation funds after KOSPI hits 10-month low
news.summary: In response to falling stock indices, South Korea's finance ministry is poised to activate market stabilisation funds. The KOSPI index has plummeted, marking its lowest point in the last ten months. An emergency meeting was convened by the finance minister to explore strategies for restoring investor confidence. Among the discussed actions are temporary regulations on stock buyback limits for publicly listed companies.

news.headline: Why gold’s five-year winning streak is under threat after dramatic selloff
news.summary: Gold has fallen to around $3,510 an ounce after hitting a record $5,594.82 earlier in 2026, putting it on track for its first annual loss in five years. A stronger dollar, elevated bond yields, profit-booking and weaker safe-haven demand continue to pressure prices.

news.headline: Reliance Brands FY26 revenue up 3.8% to Rs 3,390.9 crore; loss narrows to Rs 137 crore
news.summary: Reliance Brands has marked a significant financial milestone, achieving a revenue of Rs 3,390.89 crore for FY26 and reducing losses. Operating more than 1,085 Points of Sale nationwide, the brand continues to collaborate with over 90 partner names. Recent acquisitions, including Hamleys and new entries like Stella McCartney and Fabletics, demonstrate the company’s drive to lead in the competitive fashion and lifestyle industry.

news.headline: Nifty eyes 26,200 as rally strengthens; 6 sectors signal outperformance
news.summary: Nifty surged 2.61% last week, gaining 656 points amid strong FII inflows and improving technical indicators. Resistance lies at 25,950–26,200, while banking, IT and financial services lead sectoral momentum. Analysts advise caution against chasing extended market gains.

news.headline: Market winners: Max Healthcare, Deepak Fertilisers among 10 stocks that surged up to 14% in last week
news.summary: Max Healthcare, Deepak Fertilisers and Blue Star led Nifty 500 weekly gainers, surging 14.14%, 13.90% and 12.84%, respectively. Ten stocks outperformed the broader index, which gained 1.5%, highlighting strong momentum across healthcare, banking, real estate and other sectors.

news.headline: Gold's slide deepens as AI rout, rate-hike bets hurt bullion
news.summary: Gold prices plummeted by 3% on Friday, settling at a 14-month low of $3,502.49 per ounce. This sharp decline is largely due to a hawkish interest rate forecast and a significant selloff within AI stocks. Analysts point to forced liquidations of gold holdings as a factor, alongside increasing expectations of US borrowing costs, contributing to the commodity's bearish trend this week.

news.headline: UK stocks sink as global selloff weighs on banks and miners
news.summary: UK stocks experienced significant declines on Friday, resulting from a global market selloff linked to AI valuations. The FTSE 100 index closed at a five-month low, influenced by sharp declines in banking and mining stocks. Despite stronger-than-expected UK retail sales, declines in sectors outweighed positive news. Defensive consumer companies offered some support amid broader financial concerns.

news.headline: European shares post worst week in over a year as AI trade unravels
news.summary: European shares declined sharply, reflecting deeper worries about the sustainability of AI-related investments and overall economic growth. Concerns intensified after Anthropic's initial public offering did not restore confidence in the tech sector. The overall market decline affected various sectors, including cyclical stocks and semiconductor companies, due to profit-taking by investors. Despite recent losses, the STOXX 600 index remains up year-to-date, surpassing the performance of the S&P 500.

news.headline: Rupee climbs past 93/USD as investors seek shelter in Indian stocks, shorts unwind
news.summary: The Indian rupee has strengthened past the 93-per-dollar mark for the first time since April. This recovery is attributed to over $12 billion of foreign investments in Indian equities in November. Hedge funds have unwound bearish positions on the rupee, contributing to its recent gains. The Reserve Bank of India has taken measures to support the local currency amidst stabilization efforts.

news.headline: InvIT IPO rush gathers pace; 4-5 private trusts likely to go public by Mar 2027
news.summary: Four to five Infrastructure Investment Trusts are expected to launch public offerings to raise Rs 17,000 crore by 2027. These offerings aim to mobilise long-term capital for infrastructure development while appealing to a broader pool of investors. Notable companies like Brookfield and Investcorp are preparing to shift to public InvITs. In the past, InvITs raised around Rs 88,000 crore, demonstrating investor appetite.

news.headline: Anthropic's post-debut stumble delivers reality check for AI trade
news.summary: Anthropic’s shares fell about 9% after their market debut, deepening concerns over stretched AI valuations and showing that even a marquee listing has not revived investor enthusiasm for the sector. The focus is now shifting to whether Anthropic can justify its roughly 40-times-sales valuation and whether a potential OpenAI IPO next year can restore appetite for AI stocks.
